content: winsound (3.12 docs): PlaySound(file, SND_FILENAME|SND_ASYNC|SND_LOOP) loops in background; PlaySound(None,0) stops. SND_LOOP requires SND_ASYNC; SND_MEMORY cannot combine with SND_ASYNC/SND_LOOP; SND_PURGE unsupported on modern Windows. MessageBeep(MB_ICONHAND) plays SystemHand. Beep blocks.
